_comment: Allowed axioms per *_axiom_free / pb_*_axiom_free / helper-lemma theorem across both bridges. Lean keys use qualified names (e.g. ProofBroker.Test.foo); Rocq keys are unqualified (e.g. pb_lia_axiom_free) because Rocq's Print Assumptions doesn't include the qualifier. The CI gate (tools/check_axioms.py) parses build output for Lean's '#print axioms' annotations and Rocq's `Print <name>.` + `Print Assumptions <name>.` paired blocks. Adding a new closure path is a deliberate decision — if it grows the trust footprint, this file documents the new ceiling. See RETROSPECTIVES/phase-4.md.
